cohort: Premature newborns weighing <1,500 g and/or with a gestational age <33 weeks, admitted to a type II neonatal intensive care unit within the Public Health System (SUS) from January/2019 to December/2022.
finding: The incidence of PIVH was 32.4% and was associated with immediate umbilical cord clamping, vaginal delivery, and surfactant use.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was identified as a risk factor for peri-intraventricular hemorrhage (PIVH).
